lines.en: Our dog, Rex, used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
lines.zh: 我们的狗雷克斯过去常常坐在前门外汪汪叫。

lines.en: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.
lines.zh: 每当他想进花园时，他就会一直叫，直到有人把门打开。

lines.en: As the neighbours complained of the noise, my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
lines.zh: 由于邻居们抱怨噪音，我丈夫花了几周时间训练他用爪子按门闩，好让自己进来。

lines.en: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.
lines.zh: 雷克斯很快就成了开门的能手。

lines.en: These days he even picks up the newspaper in his mouth and presses the doorbell with his paw.
lines.zh: 如今他甚至会用嘴叼起报纸，用爪子按门铃。

lines.en: He has also learned to put his head out of the window and bark at passers-by.
lines.zh: 他还学会了把头伸出窗外，对着路人叫。

lines.en: However, when I was going out shopping last week, I noticed him in the garden near the gate.
lines.zh: 然而，上星期我正要出去买东西时，我发现他在花园里、门边。

lines.en: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out!
lines.zh: 这一次他叫，是为了让人把他放出去！

lines.en: Since then, he has developed another bad habit.
lines.zh: 从那以后，他养成了另一个坏习惯。

lines.en: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.
lines.zh: 他一从外面把门打开，就走进花园，等着门关上。

lines.en: Then he sits and barks until someone lets him out.
lines.zh: 然后他坐着叫，直到有人把他放出去。

lines.en: After this he immediately lets himself in and begins barking again.
lines.zh: 之后他立刻让自己进来，又开始叫起来。

lines.en: Worse still, he has started letting our neighbour's dog in through the gate.
lines.zh: 更糟的是，他开始把邻居家的狗从门放进来。

lines.en: The two dogs ran all over the garden and made a terrible mess.
lines.zh: 两只狗在花园里到处乱跑，弄得一团糟。

lines.en: So my neighbour came to complain of the damage again.
lines.zh: 于是邻居又来抱怨造成的损失。

lines.en: Yesterday my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed we have not seen him since.
lines.zh: 昨天我丈夫把门拆了，雷克斯气坏了，从此我们再没见过他。

lead.question: 雷克斯为什么总在门外叫？丈夫想出了什么办法？结果又如何？
lead.warmup: 你家的宠物有没有让人哭笑不得的“仪式”？课文里的雷克斯每天坐在门外叫，被放进花园后还要再叫着出去，最后竟把大门当成玩具。读之前先想一想：英语里“过去的习惯”怎么说？used to 和 would 有什么不同？带着这两个问题听课文。
goals: 辨清 used to 与 would 表示过去习惯时的用法与区别
掌握 complain of、press ... on ...、let ... in、remove 等本课重点搭配
掌握 spend time doing、become an expert at doing 等固定结构
能复述故事情节，用本课语言点描述动物的习惯与趣事
lead.summary: 课文讲作者家的狗雷克斯因邻居抱怨噪音，被训练用爪子按门闩自己进门，很快成了开门专家；此后他养成进进出出的坏习惯，还把邻居的狗放进来惹出麻烦，最后丈夫拆掉大门，雷克斯气得离家出走。语言上要重点掌握 used to 与 would 表过去习惯。
lead.tips: 记“过去习惯”就用 used to 搭骨架、would 填动作：状态与今昔对比用 used to，反复发生的动作用 would。

questions.q: Where did Rex use to sit, and what did he do there?
questions.zh: 雷克斯过去常坐在哪里？他在那里做什么？
questions.a: He used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
questions.aZh: 他过去常坐在前门外汪汪叫。

questions.q: Why did the husband train Rex, and how long did it take?
questions.zh: 丈夫为什么训练雷克斯？花了多长时间？
questions.a: Because the neighbours complained of the noise, and he spent weeks training him.
questions.aZh: 因为邻居抱怨噪音，他花了几周时间训练它。
questions.hint: As the neighbours complained of ... 与 spent weeks training ...

questions.q: How did Rex open the gate by himself?
questions.zh: 雷克斯是怎样自己把门打开的？
questions.a: He pressed his paw on the latch.
questions.aZh: 他用爪子按门闩把门打开。

questions.q: Why was Rex barking in the garden when the writer went out shopping last week?
questions.zh: 上星期作者出门买东西时，雷克斯在花园里为什么叫？
questions.a: He was barking so that someone would let him out.
questions.aZh: 他叫是为了让人把他放出去。
questions.hint: so that 引导目的状语从句。

questions.q: Why did Rex get so annoyed after the gate was removed? What do you think happened to him?
questions.zh: 门被拆掉后，雷克斯为什么那么生气？
questions.a: Because his favourite game of getting in and out was gone; he was so annoyed that he ran away and has not been seen since.
questions.aZh: 因为他最爱的“进进出出”游戏没了；他气得跑掉了，从此再没出现。

exercises.q: 用 used to 或 would 填空：Our dog, Rex, _____ sit outside our front gate and bark every day.
exercises.a: used to / would 均可；若强调今昔对比用 used to，只说过去反复的动作用 would。

exercises.q: 汉译英：邻居们抱怨噪音。
exercises.a: The neighbours complained of the noise.
exercises.note: complain of 后接抱怨的内容。

exercises.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：My husband spent weeks _____ (train) Rex to open the gate.
exercises.note: spend 后接时间加动名词。

exercises.q: 填入适当的介词：Rex soon became an expert _____ opening the gate.
改错：He pressed his paw in the latch to let himself in.
exercises.a: He pressed his paw on the latch to let himself in.

exercises.q: 汉译英：从那以后，他养成了另一个坏习惯，还把邻居的狗放了进来。
exercises.a: Since then, he has developed another bad habit and even let the neighbour's dog in.

exercises.q: 简答：used to 与 would 表示过去习惯时有什么区别？
exercises.a: used to 既可表过去的习惯也可表过去的状态，常含今昔对比；would 只表过去反复发生的动作，不能表状态。

quiz.q: Rex used to sit ______ our front gate and bark.
quiz.note: 课文说它总坐在前门外面叫。
complain of 表示抱怨某事。

quiz.q: My husband spent weeks ______ him to press his paw on the latch.
Rex soon became an expert ______ opening the gate.
This time he was barking so that someone ______ let him out.
quiz.note: 主句用过去时，从句用 would。

quiz.q: Yesterday my husband ______ the gate and Rex got so annoyed.
